title: LinkedIn Professional Headshot
description: Studio-quality corporate headshot prompt for a polished LinkedIn profile photo
prompt: A professional corporate headshot of a [age] year old [gender] with [hair color] hair, wearing a navy blue blazer over a white shirt. Soft studio lighting with a neutral grey gradient background. Sharp focus on the face, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic, Canon 5D Mark IV quality.
useCase: Generating a professional LinkedIn profile photo or corporate headshot without a photographer.

title: Meta Image Prompt Generator
description: Use Claude to write optimized image prompts for Midjourney, DALL-E 3, and Stable Diffusion simultaneously
prompt:
You are an expert image prompt engineer. I want to generate an image of [describe your concept vaguely].

Write me 3 versions of this prompt:
1. For Midjourney v6.1 — keyword-first, comma-separated, with --ar and --style parameters
2. For DALL-E 3 — descriptive prose, complete sentences, with explicit negative constraints at the end
3. For Stable Diffusion — quality tags first, comma-separated, with a negative prompt section

Each prompt should be ready to copy and paste with no modifications needed.
useCase: Generating platform-optimized image prompts for any concept across all major image generators at once.
